Sufficient level of physical fitness to do the work of the trade

613.min_education: High school diploma or GED equivalent

98.jatc_name: Apprentice Training for the Electrical Industry (ATEI)

windows.evidence_quote: accepting applications for the Inside Electrical Apprenticeship Program starting 12:00noon on Sept 21, 2020

98.min_education: High school diploma or GED; or two-year Associate Degree or higher
98.aptitude_test: Qualifying score of '5' on the electrical industry aptitude test developed and validated by the American Institutes for Research
98.math_requirement: One full credit of high school algebra with a passing grade, or one post high school algebra course with a passing grade, or NJATC Online Tech Math Course
other_requirements: Physically and mentally able to safely perform or learn to perform essential functions of the job
Able to get to and from work at job sites anywhere within the geographical jurisdiction
Able and willing to attend all required related classroom training
Able to climb and work from ladders, poles and towers of various heights
Able to crawl and work in confined spaces such as attics, manholes and crawlspaces
Able to read, hear and understand instructions and warnings
Official transcripts for high school and post high school education required
Veterans must submit DD-214 to verify military training and/or experience
$40 money order payable to ATEI required at application pickup
Valid identification required when picking up application packet

46.program_name: Puget Sound Electrical Joint Apprenticeship and Training Committee (PSEJATC) Apprenticeship
46.jatc_name: Puget Sound Electrical Joint Apprenticeship and Training Committee (PSEJATC)

windows.evidence_quote: As of May 1, 2026, Puget Sound Electrical JATC has stopped accepting new applications.

occupations: Limited Energy / Sound and Communication Technician
46.aptitude_test: Testing is referenced as part of the application process (testing and interviews for applications in process will continue)
46.math_requirement: One full year of high school Algebra (Inside Wire) or one full year of high school Math (Limited Energy, Residential) with a grade of C or better; OR one quarter of college Algebra/Math with a grade of C or better
other_requirements: Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license
Applicants in Washington State must have a valid Washington State driver's license
$75.00 application fee required to start application
60 days to complete application and submit required documentation
Official high school transcript or GED required (diplomas not accepted)
Background check form required
Substance Abuse Policy acknowledgement required
Work within IBEW Local 46 jurisdiction (King, Kitsap, Jefferson, Clallam counties)
46.notification_instructions: PSEJATC will provide a minimum of 30-days public notice prior to reopening applications; check psejatc.org for updates.
